Notre Dame Athletics' official identity guide identifies the standardized 2015 interlocking ND monogram as the primary identifier across all sports. IU Athletics' official 2018 Brand and Uniform Guidelines define a flexible mark system. The primary fan-facing marks combine the IU trident with the INDIANA wordmark (centered or horizontal); sport-specific marks are a separate tier, while Script Indiana and the Block I are spirit/retail or select-use marks, not substitutes for the primary system. The guide's mark pages were inspected, but the diagrams are reference artwork rather than standalone production assets. No standalone asset was captured, so status remains partial. Official colors: IU Crimson #990000 and White (Cream is treated as white for marketing); secondary limestone tones are accents only. Approved art must not be recreated, stretched, recolored or rearranged.

Purdue's current official Brand Studio identifies the Motion P as the signature symbol representing Purdue's athletic tradition and presents the Motion P with the University wordmark as the official institutional logo. The public guidance also cautions campus units against using the Motion P as a standalone graphic on promotional merchandise, so institutional logo rules should not be casually conflated with every Athletics application. No current standalone Athletics production asset was captured or visually inspected; status remains partial. Official primary colors: Boilermaker Gold #CFB991 and Black #000000. The train/Boilermaker Special and Purdue Pete are separate secondary/spirit imagery, not the Motion P.

Illinois Athletics' official logo page explicitly states that the primary 'I' / Block I logo is the foundation and main identifying device for the Athletics brand. The Victory Badge / Athletics Shield is a secondary Athletics-only mark containing the primary Block I; it must not be mistaken for the primary logo. The public page displays logo previews, but no standalone production asset was independently captured and visually inspected. Status remains partial. The 2014 Athletics identity announcement lists the primary palette as Navy #13294B and Orange #E04E39, with white and grays secondary. Trademark use requires prior approval from the Licensing and Trademark Office.

Central Michigan Athletics' 2023–24 official Media Content Guide explicitly labels the Action C as the PRIMARY LOGO. It prescribes Gold/White on dark backgrounds, Maroon/Gold on light backgrounds, and a single-color brand-color version; the mark may not be stretched, rotated, skewed, recolored or given unauthorized strokes. The PDF's page-5 artwork and use examples were visually inspected, but they are embedded guide art rather than a standalone production file. No direct production asset was captured, so status remains partial. Official palette: Gold #F9AB18, Maroon #4C0027, White #FFFFFF and Gray #787878. The varsity Chippewa wordmark system is a separate team wordmark family.

Eastern Michigan Athletics' publicly available Style/Brand Guide (Version 2.0, August 2013) explicitly identifies the Athletics Block-E as its primary logo and distinguishes it from other university Block-E variants; secondary logos must be accompanied by the primary. The guide is old, and current public sources also describe newer alternate branding (including Ypsi Connect), so the current department-wide primary hierarchy should be reconfirmed before production use. The guide's Block-E images were visually inspected, but no standalone current production asset was captured. Status remains partial. The 2013 guide specifies Green #006633 and White #FFFFFF, with Black permitted. Marks may not be altered, distorted, rotated or combined with a wordmark; outside use requires written Athletics consent.

Western Michigan's June 2025 Visual Identity guide explicitly states that NCAA Division I Athletics uses the Bronco Spirit Mark as its PRIMARY logo and the institutional Brand Mark as its SECONDARY logo; the Spirit Mark is restricted to Athletics and is not for other university divisions. The guide displays the Spirit Mark above a WESTERN MICHIGAN wordmark as a composite reference lockup, not a standalone production file. No standalone production asset was captured, so status remains partial. Current primary colors are Gold #F1C500, Brown #532E1F and White #FFFFFF; gold is dominant. Contact marcom@wmich.edu to obtain approved creative assets. Do not substitute the institutional circle-W mark for the Athletics primary.

Toledo Athletics' official branding page explicitly states that the primary athletic logo is to be used for all Toledo logo needs and that the secondary Rocket logo is used only after the primary has appeared. The page provides separate PNG download links for approved primary background variants and prohibits stretching, distortion, rotation, discoloration or texture. The download links are exposed through Sidearm image pages; no standalone production asset was captured and visually inspected in this pass, so status remains partial. Official colors: Midnight Blue #0B2240 (Pantone 289 C) and Athletic Gold #FFCD00 (Pantone 116 C). Sport-specific tags are sub-branding, and internal alternate identities must not replace the primary.

Ball State's official brand page identifies the Cardinal Head as the athletics logo for men's and women's intercollegiate athletics and reserves it for official Athletics business, including uniforms, publications, programs and licensed apparel. The 2025 university Brand Guidelines also call it the University Cardinal mark and distinguish the restricted retail-only vintage Dancing Charlie mark. The official page requires permission for all logo use; no standalone production asset was captured and visually inspected, so status remains partial. Official Cardinal Red is #BA0C2F and White #FFFFFF; Dark Gray #54585A is an additional neutral. Do not substitute the institutional Beneficence logo or vintage mascot art.

The University of Cincinnati's official standards identify three Athletics marks: C-Paw, Cincinnati Wordmark and Bearcats Wordmark. The Bearcat cartoon is explicitly a secondary spirit asset and may not serve as an identifying mark for a university unit. The public guide does not unambiguously designate one of the three Athletics marks as a universal department-wide primary, so the database does not invent that hierarchy. The page previews are not standalone production assets; none was captured and visually inspected. Status remains partial. Official university primary palette is UC Red #E00122, UC Black #000000 and White #FFFFFF; Athletics marks are restricted to Athletics and require review/approval for applicable use.

Louisville's official brand standards state that the Cardinal head is the primary athletic mark, and the primary signature combines that athletic mark with the university wordmark. The university's Primary Logo and Primary Signature are the main institutional marks; they may be used interchangeably depending on audience and context. Official artwork is provided through the Brand Center/high-resolution request process, but no standalone production asset was captured and visually inspected, so status remains partial. Cardinal Red is #AD0000 and Black is the other primary color; White is used for approved contrast variants. Do not recreate or typeset the mark; printed materials and merchandise require appropriately licensed vendors.

Kentucky Athletics' official identity guide identifies the interlocking UK as the primary symbol of Kentucky Athletics and says it was adopted by all athletics programs in 2005. The guide specifies two-color as the preferred primary treatment and one-color as alternate; Kentucky Blue #0033A0 and White #FFFFFF are primary, with Black #2C2A29, Cool Grey #C8C9C7 and Metallic Silver #A5ACAF secondary/limited-use colors. The PDF displays the identity and clear-space rules, but the logo art was not captured as a standalone production asset in this pass. Status remains partial. The guide explicitly prohibits constructing or scanning the mark; sport-specific wordmarks are secondary identity elements.

Ohio Athletics' 2026–27 official Branding Guide explicitly labels Arch Ohio as the PRIMARY LOGO, Attack Cat as the SECONDARY LOGO and Solo Attack Cat as the TERTIARY LOGO. Script Bobcats and Cursive Ohio are alternative logos. The guide's pages show the hierarchy and approved color/background variants, but the displayed marks are guide artwork rather than standalone production files; no standalone asset was captured and visually inspected, so status remains partial. Official digital green is #154734, with Black #000000 and White #FFFFFF. Athletics lockups are governed by the guide; sport programs may not invent or modify their own distinct logos or wordmarks.

Miami University's official brand standards identify the Miami M mark as the Athletics primary mark and distinguish it from the university's institutional wordmark and RedHawk mascot imagery. The guide/page establishes the identity and usage hierarchy, but the displayed mark is reference art and no standalone production asset was captured and visually inspected in this pass. Status remains partial. Official colors: Miami Red #C41230 and White #FFFFFF; Black is used as a supporting neutral. Use the official approved files and do not redraw, distort or recolor the M mark.

The current March 2026 BGSU Athletics Brand Standards continue to identify the Peek-A-Boo interlocking BG/falcon as the PRIMARY mark; the official Athletics standards page labels it 'Primary Peek-A-Boo' and provides JPG/EPS downloads. The official BGSU athletics-logo.png was captured and visually inspected in the earlier asset pass; the July 2026 'Marching Tradition Forward' campaign explicitly says the primary logo remains unchanged, while Marching Freddie is an alternative heritage look. Official FY26 palette: Orange #FD5000, Brown #4F2C1D, Tan #CDA077, Black #000000. Marks are controlled under CLC licensing; no distortion, recoloring, cropping or effects.

Akron Athletics' official branding resource identifies the Zips wordmark and Z logo family as Athletics identity assets and distinguishes the Zippy mascot mark. Public materials do not clearly establish a single universal department-wide primary mark across all applications, so no hierarchy has been invented. The public page previews are not standalone production files, and no official standalone asset was captured and visually inspected; status remains partial. Akron Blue #041E42 and Akron Gold #A89968 are the core colors, with White as a supporting color. Do not substitute the mascot for the Athletics wordmark/mark system; use approved artwork and licensing channels.

Kent State Athletics' official identity materials distinguish the primary Kent State K mark/wordmark system from secondary Golden Flashes and mascot/spirit imagery. The available public page and guide previews support the identity system, but the current page does not provide a directly inspected standalone production asset in this pass. Status remains partial. Official colors: Kent State Blue #003976 and Kent State Gold #EAAA00, with White as a contrast color. Athletics marks are protected trademarks; do not alter, recreate or use without required authorization.

WKU Athletics' official branding resources identify the Hilltopper head and WKU wordmark/lockup family as its athletics identity and distinguish Big Red as the mascot/spirit character rather than a replacement for the athletic logo. The public references do not unambiguously identify one universal primary lockup for every use, and no standalone official production asset was captured and visually inspected. Status remains partial. Official WKU Red is #C8102E and White #FFFFFF; Black is a supporting neutral. Do not use Big Red as the school logo or reconstruct official marks.

UMass Athletics' official branding guidance distinguishes the Minuteman head/athletic mark and UMass wordmark family from the university's institutional seal and mascot imagery. The public guidance is insufficient to confirm one single department-wide primary mark across all sports and applications, so the hierarchy is recorded conservatively. No standalone current Athletics production asset was captured and visually inspected; status remains partial. Official UMass Maroon #881C1C and White #FFFFFF are the core palette, with Black as a supporting neutral. The seal is not an Athletics logo; use only approved Athletics artwork and follow trademark/licensing requirements.

Maroon #881C1C / White #FFFFFF primary; Black #27251F / Grey #B1B3B3 secondary. Marks protected; written permission required.
